errors.text_span: This pie chart represents the distribution of different categories of quantification. The chart consists of five distinct slices

The 'Negation' slice is orange, not purple.
The 'Universal Quantifiers' slice is light blue, not orange.
The 'Comparative Relationships' slice is light blue, not gray.
The 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive' chart contains two slices: 'Disjunctive' (light blue) and 'Conjunctive' (light pink). The machine-generated description incorrectly groups them as one slice.
The machine-generated description does not mention that there are three separate pie charts representing 'Categorical,' 'Approximate Number Generation,' and 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive.'
The machine-generated description omits the 'Limiter' slice (27.91%) from the 'Categorical' pie chart.
The machine-generated description omits the 'Approximate Quantities' slice (45.03%) from the 'Approximate Number Generation' pie chart.
